summary_1line: After Kichaka’s kin are slain, Virata fears Gandharva wrath, orders their cremation, and asks Sairindhri to leave, while she requests thirteen more days.

image_candidates.scene_text: The bodies of the slain Kichakas lie scattered across the ground like a forest of uprooted trees after a hurricane.
Draupadi, newly freed, walks back toward the city like a frightened doe while townspeople scatter in fear of the unseen Gandharvas.
Bhima stands at the kitchen gate like a gigantic enraged elephant as Draupadi secretly bows to him, calling him the Gandharva who saved her.
